post.description: Submit a transform and poll the task in the Location header. Supply a new UUID in Idempotency-Key for each intended operation; reuse that UUID and the identical body for safe retries. After an ambiguous timeout, check GET /document-transforms/admissions/{idempotency_key} before resubmitting. For pasted Markdown, use source.kind=markdown with UTF-8 content. For a file, POST /document-transforms/uploads, PUT the bytes to the returned GCS URL, and submit source.kind=uploaded_markdown with upload_id, name, and destination_folder_id. Set mode to format, unslop, or both. Copy is the default.
